# Alison

> Alison is a free online learning platform offering thousands of courses, diplomas, and certificates across professional and personal development disciplines.

Alison has served over 15 million graduates worldwide with CPD-accredited courses spanning IT, health, business, languages, and more. The platform provides flexible offline learning through its mobile app and supports multiple languages including Spanish and English.

## Key Topics

- Free online courses
- Certificates and diplomas
- Professional development
- Skill-building

- [Free Online Courses & Online Learning | Alison](https://alison.com/en): Alison homepage: free online courses with certificates for 15M+ graduates
- [Learn Offline Anytime, Anywhere, With The Alison App](https://alison.com/mobile/online-learning-app): Alison App product page for offline learning and course downloads
- [Alison | Cursos en línea gratis y Aprendizaje en línea](https://alison.com/es): Spanish language homepage offering free courses and certificates

## Course Categories

- [Free Online IT and Computing Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/it): IT and computing courses: programming, cybersecurity, web development
- [Free Online Health and Medicine Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/health): Health and medicine courses: caregiving, mental health, nutrition, fitness
- [Free Online Business Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/business): Business courses: finance, management, leadership, entrepreneurship
- [Free Online Management Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/management): Management training courses for leadership and professional skills
- [Free Online Language Courses | Learn a Language | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/language): Language courses: French, German, Spanish, Italian and more
- [Free Online Sales & Marketing Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/marketing): Sales and marketing courses for professional development
- [Free Online Engineering & Construction Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/engineering): Engineering and construction courses for problem-solving and design
- [Free Online Teaching & Academics Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/education): Teaching and education courses for curriculum and pedagogy skills
- [Free Online Personal Development Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/personal-development): Personal development courses for self-improvement and skill-building
